releaseChecks.packageDryRun: 30 expected release files; no test homes, raw evidence, scratch files or SDK payload included. No package was published.
releaseChecks.repositoryTests: All non-oracle suites passed; oracle retained 134 passes and eight confirmed historical EUR snapshot mismatches, with nonzero overall exit status.

disposition: Final consistent evidence is ready for release review with explicit model limitations and the EUR snapshot caveat. No failed cases were retried, relabeled or imported from earlier runs; no new model blocks or historical-rating promotions were applied.
limitations: A pass is for this bounded workflow and one sampled conversation, not a guarantee of perfect future behavior.

The 350 produced reports passed existing scope, verification, arithmetic, HTML and final-total grading. This is not an independent pricing-oracle check for every report or a full semantic review of advice.
All 11 flagged cases produced no report. This does not imply the models never attempt a scope mistake: the MAI token-quantity error was caught before pricing.
All 19 models passed refused approval and no successful approval bypass was observed. This is not unrestricted-shell or native-form certification.
Counts supersede earlier partial evidence for current recommendations but do not alter historical scores. Do not select the best outcome from different runs or combine them into a synthetic score.
MAI-Code-2.x1 and both HydraFusion previews remain excluded and untested. The tested MAI-Code-2-Flash preview and internal-only GPT-5.6 Sol Fast retain their labels.
